task.name: Diagnosis evidence and speculative repair advice share untyped fields, so an investigator's fix guess lands in the body the dev reads as spec
task.story_text:
## Why

The diagnosis artifact has no field typed for speculative repair advice, so investigators put it where it fits — `notes`, `fix_success_criterion`, `related_findings` — and the renderer publishes those fields verbatim into the issue body, where a dev reads them with the same authority as the confirmed cause. In the last two weeks, 14 diagnosed bugs carried fix prescriptions this way: "The fix belongs in the tool-free single-shot API dispatch layer (runners/api.py…)" (#2501), "may be as simple as routing … through this existing path" (#2189), a named test file in a fix-success criterion (#2191). The artifact contract invites this: `notes` is specified only as "any caveats, unresolved threads, or partial-investigation context."

Evidence, requirements, and proposed implementation are three content classes sharing undifferentiated fields. The confirmed-localization class (cause, affected code path, evidence, behavioral fix-success criterion) is required by the fix-ready doctrine and belongs in front of the dev. The speculative-repair class is an investigator's guess that arrives dressed as diagnosis.

This is a taxonomy correction, not a removal: forge-diagnosed bugs are currently the best-performing cohort in the audit window (13 sprinted issues: zero re-runs, $4.71 median cost, 6% change-request rate vs 44% for hand-diagnosed), and the unverified advice may be contributing to that. The split must not reduce what the dev learns about where the bug *is* — only mark what the investigator merely *suspects* about the fix as advisory rather than letting it read as spec.

## Acceptance criteria

- The renderer writes confirmed cause, affected code path, evidence, hypotheses, and the behavioral fix-success criterion into the issue body exactly as today — the confirmed-localization class loses nothing.
- A repair proposal the investigation did not verify is recorded in a field typed as advisory; the landed artifact preserves it where the operator can read it, and wherever it renders it renders marked as advisory — a consumer of the body can tell verified localization from unverified proposal without judging the prose.
- An artifact containing no repair proposal renders a body with no advisory apparatus — the empty case emits nothing.
- The artifact contract states which content class each field carries, so an investigator has a typed destination for a repair idea and `notes` is no longer the untyped default for it.

## Example

Today, #2501's body ends:

```
### Notes
The fix belongs in the tool-free single-shot API dispatch layer
(runners/api.py and/or …anthropic.py), not in knowledge_summary.py.
```

After this change the confirmed cause and affected code path in that body are unchanged, and the fix-location claim above either appears explicitly marked as an unverified proposal or lives in the artifact/operator surface instead of the dev-facing prose — whichever the design lands on, the dev can no longer mistake it for a requirement.

## Notes

Origin: authoring-quality audit + outcome measurement of issues #2136–#2501 (2026-08-17). Measurement caveat recorded deliberately: the advisory content may be part of why the diagnosed cohort performs well, which is why the criteria preserve operator and (marked) dev visibility rather than deleting the content. Selection effects (diagnose favors well-localized symptom bugs) mean the cohort comparison motivates care, not causal certainty.

conventions_soft[2].value: Keep modules single-purpose. Extract when a responsibility separates from its neighbours — never to satisfy a line count. handoff.summary: Added a new optional `advisory_repair_proposal` field to diagnosis artifacts, threaded it through prompt schema parsing and coordinator audit serialization, and rendered it only when present under an explicitly advisory heading so speculative repair advice no longer reads like confirmed diagnosis. The confirmed-localization sections remain unchanged, while the prompt contract now labels each field's content class and directs investigators to use the advisory field instead of `notes`, `fix_success_criterion`, or `related_findings` for unverified fix guesses.

findings.description: When a diagnosis emits the optional advisory repair key with no value (a bare 'advisory_repair_proposal:' line, which YAML loads as null), the parser stores the literal string None and the landed issue body gains an advisory section whose entire content is the word None, instead of emitting no advisory apparatus at all.
